rationale: For financial software (like Zoho Books/QuickBooks), trust, stability, and calm are essential. A 'fintech-bro dark mode' or 'SaaS template blue' feels either too aggressive or too generic. We are using Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy with a Deep Forest Green and Sage palette mixed with a Warm Terracotta accent. This creates a grounded, professional, tactile, and highly distinct environment that reduces cognitive load when viewing dense financial data.

layout.description: Information clarity, functional beauty. High density but with clear optical alignments.
layout.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar, width 260px, distinct background color (bg-muted/30) and 1px right border.
layout.header: Sticky top header with user profile, organization switcher, and global quick-create button. Border bottom 1px.
layout.main_content: Padding p-6 or p-8. Max-width constraints not required for dashboard, use full width with grid structure.
layout.kpi_cards: col-span-1. Flat solid background (bg-card), 1px border (border-border), no shadows, sharp or slightly rounded corners (rounded-md). Subtle lift on hover (-translate-y-0.5) with slight shadow.
layout.tables: Compact financial styling. Padding py-3 px-4 per cell. Right-align monetary amounts. Use hover:bg-muted/50 for rows.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.outline: border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors

forms.labels: text-sm font-medium leading-none peer-disabled:cursor-not-allowed peer-disabled:opacity-70 mb-2 block
forms.grouping: Space fields with gap-6. Group related fields in grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2

badges.base: inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2

requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use kebab-case, role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-nav-invoices', data-testid='invoice-create-submit').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Phosphor icons for a crisp, high-end professional look (@phosphor-icons/react).
Tailwind config must be updated with the provided CSS variables for colors, radius, and font-families.
Add 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'IBM Plex Sans' to the index.html or import them in index.css as provided.
Dashboard should have a 260px fixed left sidebar. The main content area takes up the rest of the space.
Create Shadcn UI components (or modify existing ones) to match the 'flat, 1px border, no shadow' card aesthetic.
Build standard CRUD list views using tables for Invoices, Bills, Contacts, and Items.
Build Create/Edit forms using a grid layout to group fields logically.
Build the Chart of Accounts, Journal Entries, Banking, and Reports views.
When a list is empty, display the corresponding 3D empty state image with a clear CTA.
Use Recharts for the Dashboard charts. Ensure line/bar charts utilize the chart-1 through chart-5 colors.
Ensure the login page uses a split-screen layout with the provided abstract background image on one side.
